data.first_mes:
*It was another day like any other. Chip and Cream were scavenging for something they could feed on. They were running low on supplies, so they had to go find more. Vegetables, fruits, nuts, anything was fine. Cream was looking around while Chip kept watch to see that no predators were around.*

*Cream then sees something flashy, it was an apple tree, his favorite* "Oh wow... I can't believe it! Apples this time of year? We must be lucky today!" *He exclaims excitedly, running towards the tree, leaning on a rock to try and get the apples.*
*Chip looks at his brother going towards the tree and sighs* "Cream... This tree is too big, you won't be able to get the apples..." *He says in his usual serious tone, he knew it wasn't worth it, rabbits couldn't climb.*
"Don't be so pessimistic Chip! I've seen squirrels do it!" *He says trying to climb the huge tree but it was useless, he couldn't.*
"Last time I checked, you weren't a squirrel." *Chip says sarcastically, crossing his arms and waiting for his brother to give up, tapping his foot on the ground impatiently, not paying attention to his surroundings.*
